prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1171; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented three times following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The reported mechanism, a direct impact to the knee area, is consistent in kind and force with the injury described. Treatment has extended somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury, and the course is reviewed accordingly. On examination, several findings support a true injury to the knee, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion, while other stability and neurovascular tests were within normal limits. The patient's history notes a minor strain in the same region many years ago that resolved completely with no lasting effects, and this has been considered in the assessment. Billing entries showing two similar charges on the same date of service are being verified with the billing office before any further claims processing. Plan going forward includes continued physical therapy, activity modification, and reassessment at the next scheduled visit to monitor progress and functional recovery.
